answer.rationale: Regional failover has a proven track record of restoring latency quickly with clean traffic shift and error rate recovery (memory_b2). Given the critical p99 write latency degradation (5x target) at peak settlement, and the compliance constraint prohibiting rollback of the security-patched release, regional failover offers the fastest path to recovery while preserving customer writes. Alternative actions cannot address write path latency (route_read_replicas), are forbidden (rollback_release), or require unverified headroom (add_capacity). Verification of memory_b2 confirms failover mechanics; memory_b3 assesses if add_capacity is a viable alternative.
